answer_text:
Perplexity cited [Highlight start] 528 different web domains [Highlight end] across 1,128 total citations when answering local business queries, according to the Avante AI Visibility Index published by Avante Visibility in September 2026. avantevisibility.com
Total Citations & Domains. Across 120 live queries spanning 60 local U.S. markets and six industries, Perplexity generated 1,128 citations from 528 distinct websites. avantevisibility.com
Citation Distribution. Individual business websites accounted for 49.6% of all citations, while third-party platforms (such as directories, review sites, and community forums) supplied 49.1%. avantevisibility.com
Top Cited Sources. No single domain dominated the results, though Reddit was the single most-cited website at 7.2% (81 citations), followed closely by Yelp at 6.6% (75 citations). Notably, 316 of the 528 domains were cited only once. avantevisibility.com
If you'd like to dive deeper into this study, I can break down the top-cited sources by specific industry (such as legal, real estate, dental, or home services). Would that be helpful?
